meta.title: deep-bench
meta.season_source: 2025-26 Basketball-Reference advanced + contracts tables; 2024-25 advanced for injury-return priors
meta.winsFormula: projWins = 41 + 2.7 x (teamBPM - leagueAdjustment); teamBPM = 2/3 starterBPM + 1/3 benchBPM
meta.leagueAdjustmentNote: Rotation-only samples (9-10 priced players/team) average above a true league-wide 0, since replacement-level bench minutes are structurally under-sampled. This constant recenters team strength so the 30 projections sum to a full 1230-win season, per NBA schedule identity.
meta.starterBenchShareNote: Every team's 5 starters are fixed at 32 min/game (160 total); the remaining 80 team-minutes split evenly across that team's own tracked bench players, so bench share is a consistent 1/3 regardless of how many bench players are tracked (4-6).
meta.benchSurplusFormula: benchSurplusValue = (fair-market bench payroll implied by benchWinsAboveAvg, from a league-wide regression of payroll on bench value) - actual bench payroll. Positive = bargain, negative = overpaying. Regression: payroll = $38.8M + $3.24M x benchWinsAboveAvg (r=0.25, r2=0.06).
meta.lineupModelNote: Lineup and minutes panels use the identical starterBPM/teamBPM formula and leagueAdjustment as the main table -- a team's 'current lineup' value is guaranteed identical to its table starterBPM by construction, not by cross-checking.
disclosures: 22 players (17 unproven 2026 rookies, 5 returning from season-long injury) have no 2025-26 BPM. All 22 are now imputed and flagged per-team in dataFlags, not silently dropped: rookies get a modeled placeholder (-1.5 starters / -3.0 bench, not a real stat); returning veterans (Haliburton, Lillard, VanVleet, Irving, Lyles) use their last full healthy season's real BPM as a prior.
11 unsigned free agents carry no confirmed 2026-27 salary; bench payroll is committed salary only, a lower bound.
All player value is box-score BPM from a single season (or a single prior season for imputed players): blind to fit, chemistry, coaching, and development between seasons.

benchSurplusValue is relative to the league's own revealed pricing (a regression on this dataset), not an external market valuation -- it shows who is over/underpaying *relative to how the league as a whole is currently paying for bench value*, not an absolute dollar-per-win truth.
Lineup swaps are constrained to 2-3 guards and 1-2 bigs using last-season position labels; rookies with no position history default to a neutral (wing) constraint.

Minutes-plan optima are linear with a hard 36-minute ceiling and 8-minute floor, so solutions cluster at those bounds -- read the direction and size of each delta, not the literal minutes, and treat it as an upper bound on available gain, not a rotation card.

Roster assignments (who is on which team for 2026-27) reflect a late-July/early-August 2026 offseason snapshot and were independently verified against ESPN/NBA.com transaction trackers for every major trade; unsigned restricted free agents' teams remain projections.
meta.leagueAvgBenchPayrollNote: Mean 2026-27 committed bench payroll across all 30 teams. Provided as a field so the scatter's reference line is a direct read, not computed in a component.
